answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 14840 Country: India Title: going for haj will pray qasr or as muqeem? Question: going for haj will pray qasr or as muqeem? Answer ID: 14840 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1232/1232=M/1430) One will perform salah with qasr during hajj journey. After arriving at Makkah, if he intends to stay for 15 days or more, he will perform full salah, otherwise will perform with qasr . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
